control_point: A complete and accurate Article 26 transaction report is submitted by close of T+1 for every reportable execution under MiFIR.

citations.source_name: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/590 (RTS 22) laying down standards for the content and format of transaction reports

consequence_anchor.public_source: MiFIR transaction-reporting enforcement by national competent authorities under Article 35 of Directive 2014/65/EU and Article 39 of Regulation (EU) No 600/2014
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: published administrative fines in the low- to mid-million-euro range for firms with repeated late, incomplete or inaccurate MiFIR reports

commonality_rationale: All investment firms executing reportable instruments under MiFIR must submit T+1 transaction reports to their competent authority; the obligation spans equity, fixed-income and derivatives markets and is enforced consistently across EU jurisdictions.
